title: Late Breaking Results: Mixed-Cell-Height Detailed Placement under Multi-Cell Spacing Constraints
problem: Modern circuit designs impose multi-cell spacing constraints during detailed placement. Previous approaches transform these multi-cell constraints into simpler two-cell constraints, which compromises solution quality.
motivation: Efficiently handling multi-cell spacing constraints is essential for achieving high-quality detailed placement as technology scales down.
method: The algorithm employs SAT-based methods to reduce multi-cell spacing violations with minimum displacement, followed by window-based elimination of remaining violations, and finally ILP refinement to optimize cell placement.
key_novelty: Direct handling of multi-cell spacing constraints using SAT-based violation reduction, avoiding quality loss from transformation to two-cell constraints.
contributions: SAT-based multi-cell spacing violation reduction with minimum displacement
Window-based method for complete violation elimination
19% displacement improvement and 39% runtime reduction versus state-of-the-art
primary_theme: Multi-cell spacing constraint handling in detailed placement
